sql:
SELECT p.category, p.department,
  COUNT(*) AS items_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY p.category, p.department ORDER BY revenue DESC
report: Category split by department, because the same category name behaves differently across Men and Women lines and a combined figure hides that.
